summary: Recover pre-adoption ticket identity with fenced allocator validation

delivery.outcome: Publish a bounded allocator recovery route for pre-adoption ticket identities without weakening ordinary admission, then adopt the immutable release in downstream delivery.
nonGoals: Take over expired or foreign leases
Modify adopter repositories in this ticket

architecture.decision: Explicit recovery is serialized by the existing clone allocator and the external controller lock; exact owner, live lease CAS, HEAD, dirty digest, canonical worktree, unused identity and accepted scope must match before materializing intent. Ordinary allocation remains unchanged.
interfaceChanges: Explicit pre-adoption recovery request for the local allocator
dataChanges: Create previously absent bounded ticket carriers; retain clone high-water reservation
architecture.rollback: Keep failed recovery evidence and original worktree; publish a corrective immutable release, never overwrite existing tickets or retag releases.

validation.evidence: Positive allocator recovery and fail-closed HEAD, lease, scope, identity and competing-writer regressions.
Governed material change with atomic release projections and no downstream edits.
